## Evidence preamble (#M-4 — binding)
Every claim in your report must quote raw tool output from THIS run.

## Context
Your PR #6961 (branch agy/infra-6959-gemini-default-model, worktree = your cwd, head 490e2fa289)
received a cross-family FAIL with ONE finding (full text on the PR):

`AB_GEMINI_MODEL` is resolved TWICE on the synchronous ask path: `ask_gemini`
(`_gemini.py:121-161`) resolves the env override, then `process_and_respond` (`:279-282`)
resolves again — and because real Gemini model names begin with `gemini`,
`resolve_compat_model` replaces the resolved override with the registry pin. Reviewer's live
probe: `AB_GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.1-pro-high` reached `_run_gemini_sync` as
`gemini-3.7-flash-high`. Your tests mock `process_and_respond` BEFORE the second resolution
(`test_process_routing.py:402-426`, `test_gemini_bridge.py:422-446`), so they cannot catch it.

## Shippable unit
One commit on the PR branch fixing the double resolution — resolve the model exactly once (or
carry override provenance so the second resolution is a no-op for env-overridden values) — plus
an END-TO-END regression test that drives `ask_gemini` THROUGH the real `process_and_respond`
resolution boundary and asserts the env override survives to the runner invocation. The test
must fail on the current head (mutation check: verify it reds before your fix, quote that
output) and pass after. Out of scope: anything beyond this finding.

## Steps
1. Verify cwd worktree, `git rev-parse HEAD` = 490e2fa289aa11854fd234879adb0b17c3eac3f2, tree
   clean. Else STOP and report.
2. Write the failing e2e test FIRST; run it; quote the red output (proof the finding reproduces).
3. Fix the double resolution.
4. Acceptance: both test files green via
   `/Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.venv/bin/python -m pytest
   tests/ai_agent_bridge/test_process_routing.py tests/test_gemini_bridge.py -q` + ruff on
   changed files. (`.venv/bin/pytest` launcher is broken — known; use `python -m pytest`.)
5. Conventional commit `fix(bridge): resolve gemini model once, preserve AB_GEMINI_MODEL override
   (#6959)`; push to the PR branch (you pushed the original — same remote flow). Do NOT touch
   auto-merge.
6. Report: new HEAD, red-then-green test outputs, ruff tail.

### Changes Summary
- **[`scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_gemini.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6959-gemini-default-model/scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_gemini.py#L271-L283)**: Fixed double resolution in [`process_and_respond`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6959-gemini-default-model/scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_gemini.py#L255). When called with a resolved model from [`ask_gemini`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6959-gemini-default-model/scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_gemini.py#L94), `process_and_respond` uses `model` directly instead of re-passing through `resolve_compat_model("gemini", model)` (which erroneously replaced `AB_GEMINI_MODEL` overrides with the registry pin). When `model is None`, it resolves default once via [`default_gemini_model()`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/infra-6959-gemini-default-model/scripts/ai_agent_bridge/_config.py#L52).
